item.title: Prerequisites
item.description:
Before you begin #

  1. Pair up with other attendees (optional).

  2. Open Splunk Observability Cloud. Choose one of these options:

    • Sign in to the Observability Workshop organization provided with your Splunk Show instance.
    • Register for a free Splunk Observability Cloud organization and sign in.

    Registration: Register for Splunk Observability Cloud Free

  3. Choose one supported execution path.

    The workshop requires bash, curl, jq, a text editor, outbound HTTPS, and free local ports 2222, 4318, and 13133. The Splunk Show path also requires ssh on your local computer. The scp command is optional and is needed only if you choose to transfer files manually.
